interpretation.plain_speak: The warning itself is exact, but it is short-lived. Check every write and all 16 losses are caught. Check every other write and almost half slip through; every fourth write misses 15 of 16.
interpretation.north_star_question: Defines the observability cost of dynamic memory danger: exact state is available, but a system that samples too slowly will not see it in time.
interpretation.next_stage: test whether a warning horizon that persists between checks can recover high recall at cadence2/4 by forecasting multiple writes ahead from current native state, still shadow-only
